description: Wild shape uses/day by character level — this campaign scales wild shape with character level, not standard druid class level (CLAUDE.md > Class Progression: 'Scales with CHARACTER level'). Character levels 8 and 9 are DM-confirmed (Aug 2026, the level 8->9 transition); every other entry is a best-effort continuation of that curve and has NOT been checked against the DM. The level-up flow always shows this as an editable suggestion pre-filled from this table, never applies it silently — correct any wrong value in the moment you actually reach that level.
